samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    n = data[0]
    vals = data[1:1+n]
    total = sum(vals)
    print(total // n)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
